issues.note: Perf Improver monthly issue. Commented: P3's listDue has no production caller; the live over-fetch is VocabularyReviewSessionLifecycle.start() loading repo.listAll(). Needs a maintainer decision.

fixes.note: fix(release): the appcast merge now unions - the published version wins for its platform, a platform the publish does not ship keeps its item and signature. 5 cases drive the script. 6956 tests passed. The issue number is a guess (filed this run); confirm it from the PR Closes line.
release: v0.10.3 prepared - pubspec 0.10.3+19, CHANGELOG section, docs/releases/0.10.3.md, plus a guard that a version with release notes has its CHANGELOG section. 6944 tests passed.

checks.result: flutter test green on all three branches of this run: appcast merge 6956 passed / 12 skipped, feed gate 6962 / 12, openspec link guard 6962 / 12.
check_dart_format.sh ok and flutter analyze clean on all three branches of this run.
checks.follow_up: The release scripts the branches touch are not in ci.yml's path PATTERN, so a PR that changes only those scripts skips the analyze-test job. ci.yml cannot be pushed by the agentic App.

checks.result: v0.10.2 is tagged but has NO GitHub Release object: Apple and Linux shipped, Windows and Android failed on 5 platform tests. #1123 fixes them and landed after the tag. PR #1140 (v0.10.3) is open. The release_publish.yml asset-gate step landed as #1141, so issue #1139 is closed.
checks.follow_up: v0.10.3 needs only the maintainer's tag. The macOS Sparkle EdDSA key lives in the runner's login keychain, no CI secret holds it, and the sign failure was swallowed; the new feed gate now refuses an unsigned enclosure.

checks.result: No macOS or Windows host is reachable, and dl.enjoy.bot returns 403 through the sandbox proxy, so the live appcast.xml could not be read.
checks.follow_up: A maintainer should read the published appcast.xml and confirm it holds an item for every platform the manifest advertises.

checks.result: The relative-link guard now covers docs/, README.md and openspec/. The only dead relative links left are the 21 in openspec/changes/archive/** and one vendored package README.
checks.follow_up: The archived changes are deliberately excluded - repairing them would rewrite a frozen record. A maintainer may still want them fixed by hand.

checks.result: The agentic App still cannot push .github/workflows/ - the release_publish.yml asset-gate step remains filed as an issue. .github/scripts/ stays pushable, which is where both of this run's release gates live.
checks.follow_up: The compiled *.lock.yml carries the egress allowlist, so a .github/workflows/*.md edit still needs gh aw compile.

checks.result: flutter pub outdated shows only major-version candidates beyond the constraints plus in-constraint patch bumps that #1125 already covered today. No Dependabot alerts are open.
checks.follow_up: Nothing to bundle - a dependency PR would only repeat #1125.

checks.result: Three Repo Assist PRs are open from this run: the appcast merge union, the update-feed gate, and the openspec link guard.
checks.follow_up: They are a stack - each branch was cut from the previous one, so merge the appcast merge first, then the feed gate, then the link guard. PR #1140 (v0.10.3) is independent. The stack was explained in a comment on #841.

priorities.note: The Sparkle appcast merge now unions - a single-platform publish no longer removes the other platform's update from the feed. 5 cases drive the real script.
A gate refuses to publish a feed whose latest.json and appcast.xml disagree, or whose appcast item has no Sparkle signature. jq with a python3 fallback.
The relative-link guard now scans openspec/ as well as docs/, and the two dead links in the active app-update-system proposal are repaired.

priorities.item: Decide where the macOS Sparkle EdDSA private key comes from
priorities.note: ADR-0023 wants it in a release secret, but signing depends on the runner's login keychain. The feed gate now fails the publish on an unsigned enclosure; the key source is still a maintainer decision.

priorities.item: latest.json advertises one global version while its assets are per-platform
priorities.note: evaluateUpdate compares the manifest version with no platform awareness, so a macOS user is told 0.10.3 is available when the macOS enclosure is 0.10.2. A per-platform version in the feed is a schema change.
